Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack9-OfficeHighZone]: Medium to large office buildings. These buildings zone in with heritage-styled facades. Over time, as the city grows, these buildings get new modern developments, renovations, and activations.
Assets.DESCRIPTION[Pack9-OfficeSignature:
Of this historic neo-Gothic administrative building, only ruins survived the test of time. Recently, however, the main entrance has been secured, restored, and integrated into this modern office space and houses the headquarters of a known media company.
Boosts your city's entertainment and offices.

The modest office building from the turn of the 20th century has fallen into disrepair and has recently been included as the base of a striking new high-rise tower.
The building gives your city's attractiveness and office districts a head start.

Once the location of a grand hotel, the striking historicist corner building has had an addition in the 1990s and now houses office spaces. Rumours are that an upcoming handover of the building will see the addition of a skyscraper at the core of it.
Provides well-being for the surrounding area.
Assets.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION[Pack9-OfficeS:
The Frankfort Court Tower is a striking addition to your skyline and a marvel of engineering that has been carefully added to the core of the existing office building.
Provides a city-wide attractiveness boost.
